build.beforeDevCommand: bun run build:sidecar && bun run dev:web
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run build:sidecar && bun run build:web

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* ws://localhost:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
